_about: 7 Oct, the owner: "for the chatbot test it as well same thing give me 3 example each scenario and do it like you did for the voice agent testing". The nine cards of the 4 Oct calm-word run (wa_qa_menu_buttons.json), three per menu button, moved to Wednesday 7 Oct; the fixtures keep their dates, so Dalia's leak is ten days old and Gilad's "Friday" is still 2 Oct. Free residents: a hello and a tap are scripted, then a Claude player is the person on the card. Every resident is invented and lives in בר כוכבא 23; nothing here writes anywhere. Run with --deck scripts/wa_qa_oct7_9.json.

defaults._how: What a tool returns when the scenario has no fixture for it. <ticket> is the scenario's `ticket`, <flat> the resident's flat in `knows`, <id> the scenario id.

open_request._rule: building names Bar Kochba in Hebrew (בר כוכבא, any spacing) with the number 23: opened. Bar Kochba in Hebrew with no number: need_number. Bar Kochba in Latin letters, or any other street: street_unknown. No building at all: need_building. A second call with the same building and the same type returns the FIRST ticket's reference as `duplicate` (the ticket service's 30-minute duplicate guard: same building, same type, still open); a different type gets the next serial (255-1510-26 -> 255-1511-26).

need_number.note: Nothing was opened. Ask for what is missing in one short question: the building (street and number) and, in the same question, the apartment they live in if you do not have it yet. If they answer with the building only, open the ticket with it; do not ask again. Just ask: no reason why you need it, nothing about what you will do with it.

verify_address._rule: Bar Kochba in Hebrew with 23: found. Bar Kochba in Hebrew without a number: need_number. Anything else: street_unknown.

get_service_info._rule: Match the topic's words against each entry's `words` (any one is enough); every entry that matches comes back in `topics` as {title, facts}. Nothing matches: not_found.

catalogue.title: ניהול ועד בית
facts: בונים לבניין תקציב שנתי מותאם למבנה ולמערכות שבו.
גובים את דמי הוועד מהדיירים, ושולחים קבלה דיגיטלית לכל מי ששילם.
אפשר לשלם בהעברה בנקאית, הוראת קבע, כרטיס אשראי או שיקים.
אחת לשבוע עושים התאמות בנק, רושמים הוצאות ומעדכנים את דוח המאזן.
מול ספקים חיצוניים הומיז מתנהלת, ולא הדיירים.

catalogue.title: הדברה
facts: ההדברה עונתית ומקיפה את כל הבניין: לובי, חניונים, קומות המגורים, חדרי מדרגות, ארונות, ופתחי ביוב וניקוז.
מודיעים לדיירים ולוועד לפחות שבוע מראש, עם הנחיות למה לעשות לפני ההדברה ודגשי בטיחות אחריה.
אחרי ההדברה יש אישור ואחריות לשנים עשר חודשים. האישור נשמר בתיק הבניין.
גם מקרים נקודתיים כמו קן צרעות או חולדות בחדר האשפה מטופלים.

catalogue.title: שיפוצים
facts: הומיז מבצעת שיפוצים לדירות ולבתים פרטיים: ריצוף, צבע, אינסטלציה, חשמל, עבודות איטום ועבודות גבס.
זה לא חלק מדמי ועד הבית. מי שמתעניין מקבל הצעת מחיר, וזה נרשם לצוות.

catalogue.title: ניהול נכסים לבעלי דירות
facts: שירות לבעלי דירות, לא לדיירי הבניין: איתור ובדיקת שוכרים, הכנת חוזה, טיפול בתקלות בנכס ודוחות קבועים לבעלים.
מי ששואל על זה הוא בדרך כלל בעל נכס, וזה נרשם לצוות כדי שיחזרו אליו.

not_found.note: No topic matched. Say you do not have that detail and offer the office; do not guess.

get_balance._rule: name or phone missing: need_identity (list what is missing). The card's full name and phone together (any spacing or hyphens): the scenario's balance fixture. Anything else: identity_failed.

scenarios.title: open a ticket: the lift, a man in a hurry who types in pieces

resident.persona: אבי, 45. On his way to work and in a hurry. Types fast with one thumb: short lines, no punctuation, typos (מעלת for מעלית, עכשו, אנלא for אני לא). Not rude, just busy.
resident.knows: Lives at בר כוכבא 23, apartment 9. The lift has been stuck on floor 4 since this morning with its door open; nobody is inside. He took the stairs.
resident.tendencies: Gives the address in pieces (the street without the number, or only the apartment) and fills in the rest only when asked. May ask when someone is coming. Leaves as soon as he has a ticket number, with a one-word thanks or with nothing.

scenarios.title: open a ticket: water through the bathroom ceiling, a worried woman with a photo

resident.persona: מירב, 38. Stressed and talkative: long messages with several details at once. Writes about herself in the feminine (אני לא יודעת, אני צריכה, אני בטוחה).
resident.knows: Lives at בר כוכבא 23, apartment 7, second floor. Since this morning water has been dripping from her bathroom ceiling near the lamp. She thinks it comes from the flat above, apartment 11, where nobody answers the door. She has a photo of the wet ceiling on her phone.
resident.wants: Someone to stop the leak, and someone to get hold of the upstairs neighbours.
resident.tendencies: May send the photo with no caption. May ask whether Homies can talk to the upstairs neighbours or give her their number. May worry aloud about the electricity, because the water is near the lamp.

scenarios.title: open a ticket: the parking gate again, an angry man stuck outside at night

resident.persona: רוני, 35. Angry and tired after a long day: short bursts, !!, a few harsh words (נמאס לי, מה אתם עושים בכלל), no swearing.
resident.knows: Lives at בר כוכבא 23, apartment 14. The parking gate does not open with his remote; he is sitting in his car outside. It is the third time this month, and he reported it twice before (once by phone, once here). He has no ticket numbers.
resident.wants: The gate fixed for good, and to be taken seriously.
resident.tendencies: May ask what happened to his earlier reports. May ask אתה בוט? if a reply sounds canned. Calms down a little if he feels heard; gets angrier at anything that sounds like a template.
